text:
incident-bot: PAGER: oncall -> @morgan. Incident INC-8923: inference-gateway p95 latency spike and elevated 5xx rate, starting 2026-03-16T10:15:35Z
morgan: I'm on it, pulling traces now.
tj: seeing large backlog on shard-a, KV cache throughput drop
anya: customer B2B-prod has ~30% of traffic, CS reporting timeouts for a few accounts
morgan: rolling a quick routing fallback to smaller model variant (routable r-2 -> r-1)
lee: :thumbsup:
morgan: applied routing change, starting warmup, will monitor
ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-8923 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8923
morgan: initial mitigation reduced 5xx from 5.0% -> 1.4% in ~5m
anya: customer impact: handful of low-QPS customers saw model timeouts, CS notified (CS#142)
tj: baseline cause looks like KV cache pressure + noisy large batcher groupings from one client
morgan: capturing log sample:
```
2026-03-16T10:12:34Z inference-gw shard-a batcher=group-42 kv_cache_misses=982 latency_p95=2450ms
```
lee: can we suppress the p95 alert noise during the mitigation window? it's firing every 2m right now
morgan: yes — added temporary alert silence for p95 on inference-gateway (10m)
ops-bot: Alert silence added by morgan for 10 minutes
anya: propose long-term fix: tighten batcher limits + increase kv cache size + add per-tenant backpressure
tj: +1. Also recommend changing alert to use 5m rolling p95 and add an error rate threshold at 2%
morgan: noted. I'll include concrete thresholds in the postmortem.
morgan: handing off to tj for next shift at 11:30UTC. Handoff: routing fallback still active, kv cache eviction rate remains high.
tj: taking over. I'll keep routing fallback until kv cache stabilizes or autoscale finishes.
morgan: thanks — attaching quick dashboard link for oncall: grafana/d/incident/INC-8923
tj: while monitoring, I want a new dashboard for retrospectives: single view with p95 heatmap, error rate by model, batcher queue depth, kv hit ratio, and a per-tenant drilldown
anya: and a golden signals row: latency, errors, throughput, saturation (GPU util + KV eviction)
lee: prefer drilldowns to pre-filter by tenant -> model -> batcher id
morgan: can someone draft this? I can add panel thresholds and example queries. Suggest Loki + Prom for logs/metrics.
tj: I'll create the initial Grafana board. Quick note on panels:
- p95 heatmap: histogram of p95 over last 6h, group by model
- errors by model: stacked bar, 1m resolution
- batcher queue depth: time series with alerts baked in
- kv hit ratio: gauge + sparkline
- customer drilldown: template var tenant_id -> model -> batcher_id
anya: also add a "what we changed" events panel to capture mitigations (routing fallback, alert silences, autoscale events) — helps retrospectives
morgan: good idea. Add an events panel that pulls from incident timeline (INC-8923)
tj: I'll use Grafana provisioning to import panels. Example alert rule we should update:
```
alert: InferenceHighP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) BY (le, model))
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "p95 latency high ({{ $labels.model }})"
```
morgan: change suggestion: increase `for` to 10m and add an `or` clause for error rate:
```
expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) BY (le, model)) > 1.5)
 or (sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) BY (model) > 0.02)
for: 10m
```
tj: sounds good. Also add rate-limiting per-tenant panel and an alert if one tenant contributes >40% of batcher queue
anya: can we add KV eviction as a saturation indicator (panel + alert when eviction_rate > 100/s)?
morgan: yes. I'll open a follow-up ticket to adjust alerts and add panels: MON-2153
ops-bot: MON-2153 created: Grafana: incident dashboard for INC-8923 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MON-2153)
tj: patched dashboard draft at grafana/d/new/incident-INC-8923-draft — ping me for access
lee: nice. For post-incident, update runbook steps: add "apply routing fallback", "silence p95 for mitigation window", "check kv eviction and autoscale", "contact CS for affected tenants"
morgan: agreed — I'll add to runbook and link in postmortem.
anya: postmortem summary: root cause = burst of large batching from tenant X + insufficient kv cache sizing on shard-a. Remediation: per-tenant batching caps, kv cache autoscale, improved alerting. ETA: 2 weeks for config changes, 4 weeks for infra follow-ups.
tj: thanks everyone. closing live mitigation — will follow up with PRs for Grafana provisioning and alert rule changes.
morgan: marking incident resolved in ticket. final metrics: p95 back to baseline ~420ms, errors <0.5%
ops-bot: Incident INC-8923 resolved by morgan
morgan: thanks all :bow:
anya: adding retrospective notes to #incidents-docs
lee: :party-parrot:
